svg.title: Immortal annulus: three finite stages and the infinite-time limit
svg.desc: Original cutaway schematics at the same scale show a narrowing positive neck and two sheets flattening locally. At infinite time one plane is counted twice. The far ends retain their original asymptotic heights; only a fixed radial window is drawn. These are not computed MCF time slices.
svg.text: Immortal annulus · a sequence of schematic stages
0 < t₁ < t₂ < t₃ · the same local window and scale
Neck still positive at finite time
Cutaways expose the neck. The far ends still approach fixed planes ±h.
Qualitative stages only: no physical times or convergence rate are assigned.
